tool_input.args: Continue: panels identified as A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H. A and B contain super-resolution localization/density map images (PALM data - point-based renderings, not conventional micrographs but classified as micrograph type per skill since acquired via microscopy - 3D PALM). F and H contain super-resolution trajectory/kymograph images (sptPALM). C, D, E are plots. G is histogram/plot. Need to check scale bars on A, B, F, H panels.
